Simulation results show that recognition accuracy of Velocity Search (VS) / Single Target Track (STT) / Range While Search (RWS) / Track While Scan (TWS) modes reaches 97%, proving good recognition performance and practical value of proposed method.

articleTitle: High precision algorithm research of flight arrival time estimation based on irregular geo-grid
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Flight arrival time is of great importance for airport department of operation and ground service. Gates can be assigned and adjusted based on precise arrival time of aircrafts. At the same time, accurate arrival time can cut down waiting time greatly for follow-me vehicles, cleaning staffs, and food vehicles. This paper proposed three estimation methods, respectively corridor-passed approaching flight data reference algorithm, algorithm on the basis of square geo-grid, and algorithm based on irregular geo-grid. Lots of experiment work has been approached with these algorithms. Algorithm based on irregular geo-grid have been approved to be of highest efficiency and is most accurate. The software based on this algorithm has been developed and applied in Baiyun airport, Xianyang Airport, Taoxian Airport, etc. The system is proved to be most effective.

articleTitle: Feature selection for risk detection of strokes: A 5-year longitudinal study
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Stroke disease places a heavy burden on society in the world. Risk detection of strokes is a challenge in medical field. This paper investigates biomedical tests and electronic archives on 792 records (each record includes 28 features), which contain 398 records in the last 5 years before stroke at a community hospital. We proposed a new hyper feature selection model combined support vector machines (SVM) with the glowworm swarm optimization (GSO) algorithm based on STD (Standard Deviation) of features. The results show that the proposed model can achieve 73.23% accuracy by means of the 18 features among the original dataset<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Disturbance observer based sliding mode control for rigid spacecraft with fast power reaching law
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, a fast power reaching law based sliding mode control with disturbance observer is presented to resolve attitude tracking control problem for rigid space-craft with the existence of inertia uncertainty and external disturbance. A disturbance observer is presented to estimate the lumped disturbance with bounded change rate. Then, a sliding mode controller is designed based on the fast power reaching law with considering disturbance estimation to ensure the convergence of the attitude and angular velocity tracking errors. Lyapunov theorem is given to verify the stability of the closed-loop system. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme are illustrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Fast reading and display of remote sensing image based on Qt and GDAL
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: With the rapid development and increasing application of remote sensing technology, this paper presents a method of fast reading and display of remote sensing image based on Qt and GDAL. This method uses Qt as the development tool, which is a cross-platform graphical user interface framework, and utilizes GDAL library to construct image pyramid and read the image into memory files. Furthermore, an optimization is made by introducing block reading and cache technology. This method can achieve fast display of large-capacity remote sensing images in different operating systems, as well as smooth zooming and roaming operations on remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and analysis of natural characteristics for RV reducer
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: RV reducer is the important component of industrial robot joint arm, and dynamic characteristics is the core of its design. In the field of static mechanics, scholars have done a lot of research, the requirements of the robot joint arm on the high accuracy and vibration level are very strictly. Therefore, the dynamic research of the RV reducer is very necessary. The influence of system stiffness on the vibration characteristics is considered. The dynamic model of the system is established by using the centralized mass method for the RV320E reducer model. The natural frequency of the system is obtained by solving the free vibration equation, and use the induction method to sum up the vibration mode of first 8 natural frequency which provides the theoretical basis for the design and application of the RV reducer and guiding significance.

articleTitle: A community detection algorithm by utilizing grey wolf optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Community detection in complex network has become a most popular topic in recent years. In this paper, we propose a discrete framework of the grey wolf optimization algorithm to find community structure. First, the modularity density which can evaluate the performance of community structure is used as the objective function in our algorithm. Then, two initialization methods based on label propagation are introduced. To improve the local search ability, the hill-climbing strategy is used by the leader wolf. Moreover, the mutation operator is adopted to keep the population diverse. The results of experiments on real-world networks show that our algorithm can effectively detect the network structure and be competitive compared with the state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on grid-connected control of doubly-fed wind power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: When high-power doubly-fed wind generation system based on the doubly-fed converter is grid connected, harmonic pollution due to the grid voltage will lead to the harmonic currents. In this paper, by using the Second Order Generalized Integrator (SOGI), the PLL controller can calculate the grid frequency stably and accurately. Based on the stator flux directional control, the resonant controller is proposed to suppress the harmonic currents. Simulations and experiments show the well performance of the control strategy in dealing with the harmonic problems of grid voltage.

articleTitle: Design of battery management system based on DSP for BEV
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper proposed a design method for battery management system of battery electrical vehicle based on DSP. With DSP as the core controller, the system achieves voltage acquisition of Li-ion battery pack, current collection, temperature acquisition, active equilibrium, Batter State of Charge (SOC) estimation and Controller Area Network (CAN). Active equilibrium guarantees the consistency of battery. Insulation monitoring oversees the insulation condition of battery electric vehicle. As CAN bus circuit is designed with electromagnetic compatibility and the idea of isolation, it has a capacity of shielding electromagnetic interference on normal operation of the system. Thus, the system performance is improved. SOC estimation ensures the security and mileage range for battery cells of electrical vehicle. The developed host machine enables the accessibility of real-time data of battery pack.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors and characteristics of small hydropower generation
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: As a clean energy, small hydropower had developed rapidly in recent years. However, the generation characteristics of runoff small hydropower units were poor and had less regulation ability. These factors affect the operation of the power grid. Through the analysis, it is found that the long time scale precipitation has a strong correlation with the small hydropower output. It is volatile in summer when the rainfall is abundant, but has weak correlation with temperature and wind. Small hydropower has the cumulative effect and the hysteresis effect. This paper provides a reference for the analysis of small hydropower generation and grid connected operation, to achieve the purpose of full utilization.

articleTitle: Control algorithm design of auxiliary power unit in high-speed electric multiple unit
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Control algorithm for the auxiliary power unit (APU) of CRH2 350 km/h electric multiple unit (EMU) is designed in this paper. The front stage of APU is a four-quadrant rectifier, and the latter is a three-phase voltage inverter. Double closed-loop control algorithm based on current decoupling is used for the four-quadrant rectifier. Double closed-loop control algorithm based on voltage and current decoupling is used for the three-phase voltage inverter. In order to suppress the large amount of output voltage harmonics due to the auxiliary rectifier applied as load, a repetitive control loop is added to the instantaneous voltage loop. In addition, a novel short-circuit current limiting control algorithm is designed for the three-phase inverter. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed controller is verified by simulation and experimental results of a 220kVA APU. The single-phase input power factor closely achieves one when fully loaded. The output voltage THD reduces significantly under rectifier load. APU could limit the short-circuit current properly, and quickly restore the rated output without protection action when short-circuit is removed.

articleTitle: Mechanical characteristics optimization of ballast bed variable on operating process for the dynamic track stabilizer
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The ballast bed is the foundation of the track system, simulation analysis of the variation rule of the ballast bed variable under the operating process of the dynamic track stabilizer, is valuable for the simulation of vehicle track systems. In this paper, a method for calculating the equivalent stiffness and damping of the ballast bed by discrete element method was presented. EDEM was a software of discrete element method, which was used to simulate the operating process of the dynamic track stabilizer. It was found that after two times of stabilize operating, the state of ballast bed tends to be stable, and there was no practical effect on the ballast bed when it is continuous operating, and the value of the support stiffness of sleeper was increased by about 7 times than before. According to the simulation data, the function model of the support stiffness of sleeper, damping and cumulative settlement of ballast bed was established under the operating process of the dynamic track stabilizer, which provides the effective ballast bed variables in order to further improve the accuracy of dynamic stability of vehicle track coupling systems.

articleTitle: Electricity market decision support system for power plants
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: With the introduction of electricity market, the production mode of power industry will be gradually changed from planning mechanism to market mechanism. To adapt to the market situation, power plants or power companies (independent power provider, IPP) need to strengthen their production management and cost management to get more benefits, meanwhile another way to increase income is to optimize their bidding strategies. This paper presents a decision support system for power plants, which comprises 8 subsystems: cost management system, production management system, forecast and decision system, local data acquisition system, market data acquisition system, settlement system, bidding management system and system configuration.

articleTitle: Carrier tracking loop design for high-dynamic BeiDou receivers
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The conventional GNSS receiver is easy to lose lock in carrier-phase tracking loop under high-dynamic conditions, to improve tracking accuracy a new carrier tracking loop based on Adaptive Square-root Cubature Kalman filter (ASCKF) is proposed. Firstly, fine frequency estimation based on the phase measurement is used to provide precise initial value for the tracking loop. Secondly, the ASCKF-based carrier tracking loop depending on the structure of BeiDou2 navigation signal is designed. Finally, the adaptive factor according to the detection of carrier-to-noise ratio (CNR) and movement state is derived to adaptively calibrate the measurement noise covariance and the process noise covariance. The simulation results verify that the proposed algorithm could work well with the jerk up to 200g/s, and it has higher tracking accuracy compared with the algorithm based on adaptive extend Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Experimental and modeling study on the creep characteristics of geogrid
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The creep of geogrid is an important factor which affects the safety and stability of reinforced structure. It is difficult to make a quantitative description of the creep effect of geogrid due to the fact that the creep of geogrid sustains a long period of time. In this paper, the creep process of geogrid is quantitatively studied by method of indoor experiment and together with theoretical derivation. In the study, an advanced digital speckle system was used to record the movement of particles in the experiment. The results show that the creep model is suitable to describe the strain distribution and the creep behavior of geogrid in time domain and space domain.

articleTitle: Analytical and numerical analysis of the sub-harmonic resonance
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The planetary gear is a nonlinear parametric excitation system. Because of the structural symmetry, certain primary resonances can be suppressed by adjusting the meshing phases of the planets. The sub-harmonic resonance shows distinct characteristics from the primary resonance for the different excitation mechanism. However, this difference does not draw much academic attention. With a nonlinear lumped parameter model, the sub-harmonic resonance of an example planetary gear is obtained using numerical integration. Whether the meshing rule for suppressing certain primary resonance is applicable for the sub-harmonic resonance is verified numerically. The difference between primary and sub-harmonic resonance is exposed via numerical and perturbation analysis.

articleTitle: A muti-organ localization method in CT volumes
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a robust method for multi-organ localization of 3D CT images. Improved Haar-like feature is implemented to narrow down the beginning and ending positions of organ slices. Relying on the fact that voxel intensity of one organ may approximate to others', characteristics metrics are generated based on intensity and spatial position of every single voxel in a target area and trained by random forests afterward, such that a more robust output is presented as a probability density. A polished user interface is also designed deliberately for display of patient's organ bounding boxes.

articleTitle: Aircraft engine decentralized tracking control: A new LMI approach
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper considers the decentralized tracking control of large-scale systems. The novelty of the paper comes from the consideration of introducing adjustable parameters to linear matrix inequalities (LMI). These adjustable parameters can adjust the convergent rate of tracking error signals and the coupling between subsystems. This method is applied to aircraft engine decentralized tracking control, simulation results have shown its validity.

articleTitle: Analysis of airdrop and safe landing of the multi-joint snake robot
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The snake robot is a multi-joint and link-type robot, and its joints are the weakest parts of the whole body. In order to deliver the snake robot designed with cross-type universal joint to the target area quickly and safely, the stability control of the falling speed of the airdrop snake robot and landing impact on the joints are mainly studied in this paper. An appropriate parachute is designed to control the falling speed of the robot. After the separation between the robot and parachute, the impact force and impact torque of 7 landing attitudes in different ways of joint constraints upon the joints are simulated by SimWise4d, and analyzed to find an optimal landing attitude. Then the maximum impact acceleration in this optimal landing attitude on whole body is analyzed to reduce the landing impact as more as possible. The simulation result provides the basis for the design of the landing attitude and joint optimization of the multi-joint and link-type robot, which has a great value to the airdrop and safe landing of this kind of robots.

articleTitle: Error analysis of a 5-DOF hybrid mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of a new type of hybrid mechanism, this paper analyzes the error of the new mechanism. In this paper, we use the vector chain method to establish the model of parallel part. The serial part is modeled by DH method, and the two parts are connected by moving the platform. And each error source of the parallel and serial parts is determined by first-order perturbation and parameter perturbation respectively. The error sources of the mechanism end errors are determined. The influence of the error sources on the end-position is confirmed by simulation, which makes sense for the design and manufacture of a mechanism. Based on the analysis of the parallel part of the error, it is found that the error of the single chain is not simply accumulated to the end of the parallel mechanism but decoupled to the end, and there is the difference between the error after coupling and the error of the single vector chain, which provides a valuable reference to analysis of the error of the parallel mechanism.

articleTitle: Fluid solid coupling in the process of feeding the cylinder
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Food, pharmaceutical and other industries have many production process of material mixing, the mixture has both the solid material itself and the need for a homogeneous mixing of the gas liquid material with the solid material, the effect of mixing directly affects the consistency of quality and quality of products. Traditional experimental and theoretical methods are difficult to reveal the internal law of mixing process and affect the evaluation and optimization of mixing effects. The discrete element method is an effective method to study the mixing process of solid materials, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is an effective method for the study of gas liquid factors, the two coupling can well describe the internal law of the mixing process. In this paper, Eulerian-Eulerian method is used to realize the coupled analysis of mixing process.

articleTitle: Analysis of aerodynamic characteristics of a modular assembled missile with canard rudder and arc tail
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: A modular assembled missile is designed recently. We can assemble different cabins just before launching to meet different requirements, and in this paper we choose one of the combinations of the cabins for analysis. Firstly, we use the commercial software Fluent to simulate the aerodynamic of the missile with arc tail and canard rudder in the high maneuvering state at different attack angles and different flying Mach number. Next, by changing the boundary conditions of simulation, the variation law of the lift coefficient, the drag coefficient and the pitch moment coefficient with the changing flight velocity of the missile module is obtained. In the subsonic and supersonic state, pressure cloud of the missile and the surrounding were both observed, then we compare them to verify the credibility of the simulation. At last we make conclusions about the shortcoming and advantages of the missile's shape, and introduce our future works.

articleTitle: Comparative study of active engine mount control methods
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Active engine mounts (AEMs) provide an effective solution to further improve the acoustic and vibrational comfort of passenger cars. In this study, the structure of the electromagnetic actuator is analyzed, and the electromagnetic actuator frequency response is derived, the lumped parameter model of an AEM is built. With the help of Matlab/Simulink, the vibration isolation system model is set up based on LMS feedforward adaptive control, RLS feedforward adaptive control, FxLMS adaptive control, LQR optimum control, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> robust control, H„ robust control, PID feedback control, fuzzy control, fuzzy-PID control. The vibration isolation performance of the nine algorithms are compared based on force transmissibility.

articleTitle: Establishment of creep model of non-asbestos sealing composite material by beater-addition process and the creep performance research
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Creep resistance is one of the important properties of the sealing material, which is the main factor affecting the life of the gasket. There are many factors influencing on the creep properties due to the fact that non asbestos gasket materials is a kind of composite material of multiple component. The theoretical research, experimental study and the establishment of mathematical model of the creep are the popular field. In this paper, based on non-asbestos gasket materials, through the combination of 5 Kelvin model and 1 Maxwell model series, the creep constitutive equation of non-asbestos gasket materials at constant temperature under constant load condition was established, and the creep properties was tested and fitted. It is shown from the results that the creep model can be used to reflect the creep characteristics of the material. The obtained creep curve shows that the creep of the gasket mainly occurs in the initial 10h. With the increase of stress, the initial deformation of the gasket increases, and the deformation of the gasket increases with the increase of time. At the same time, the creep variable fitting shows a relatively well log curve characteristic, so the creep data can be fitted by the log curve.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation of mechanical parts based on fully convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Machine vision detection and recognition technology has a wide range of advantages such as non-contact, real-time online, fast, strong anti-interference ability. This technology has been used to achieve zero inferior parts production of mechanical parts, to meet the requirements of modern manufacturing progress and development. In the actual production it shows a broad application prospects. In this paper, we apply the Fully Convolutional Networks (FCN) method to the robot vision system for mechanical part inspection. We found that the use of FCN can make the classification accuracy quickly reach a stable value, thus greatly reducing the training time. The proposed method is based on (1)our own database is collected on an industrial conveyor belt, which contains 2248 images of various types of parts with different sizes, (2) Fully Convolutional Networks(FCN) is trained by using back-propagation algorithm to extract valuable features from input training data, and realized pixel-level semantic classification on the validation images.

articleTitle: Power management development for FWorks
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: FWorks, the acronym for FADEC Works, is a new digital simulation platform, developed for research on aircraft engine control system design, development, testing and integration. Power Management is a function of FWorks, which generates the control reference for the main control loop of the aircraft engine from the aircraft throttle resolver angle and flight conditions, and ensures that the engine produces the required thrust by the aircraft over the full flight envelope. In this paper a method is proposed to develop such a power management scheme, and the preliminary design for cruise flight phase is integrated into and validated in FWorks.

articleTitle: Error analysis of UHF partial discharge monitoring system based on ensemble empirical mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The ultra-high frequency (UHF) partial discharge monitoring device which is now used in power grid has the phenomenon of lacking the accuracy of measurement as well as the outcome reliability. In order to improve the metrical precision of UHF partial discharge monitoring system and analyze the features of its error, the analytical method of dynamic measurement system based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition is provided in this paper. When mutation or interval exists in the signal component of the original signal, using Empirical Mode Decomposition may lead to modal aliasing phenomenon. Otherwise, the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition overcomes the defect in truncated signal and restrained the modal aliasing phenomenon at a certain extent. By using simulation, the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition can make the error signal adaptively decompose into several simple signal so it brings us some convenient in research and finally validates the availability of our method.

articleTitle: Optimized torque allocation strategy on multi-wheel vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Multi-wheel vehicles are extensively utilized in civil and military fields, since they are powerful in complex environment, originating from over-actuated multi-wheel driven system. It is necessary that the kinematics and dynamics of all wheels have to be coordinated controlled. In this paper, the optimized torque allocation strategy on skid steering multi-wheel vehicle driven by independent in-wheel motors has been proposed based on vehicle dynamical model and wheel torque distribution characteristics. Subsequently, weighting control allocation error and control energy as the optimization target, wheel torque control allocation was solved using quadratic programming method. Integrated with wheel slip control and actuator fault redundancy control schemes, the optimization algorithm is correspondingly implemented, which improved the dynamic performance and safety of steering vehicle. The effectiveness of wheel torque distribution strategy was validated in Matlab/Simulink which demonstrated that torque can be redistributed among the effective motors when one wheel motor fails.

articleTitle: Time domain synchronous averaging based on accurate alignment reference signal
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Time domain synchronous averaging can be a useful signal analysis and pre proceeding technique in condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of rotating and reciprocating machines. It reduces the signals not coherent to rotation frequency effectively, and extracts the repetitive signals directly related to machine operation condition. This paper proposes a method to improve the traditional time domain synchronous averaging, and discusses the time domain synchronous averaging method based on the accurate alignment reference signal. Searching the phase reference data for the linearly interpolated between the points on either side of the zero-crossing level, the vibration data are then digitally re-sampled with interpolation, using the cumulative phase angle results to provide the re-sampling positions. Analysis results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the improved time domain synchronous averaging in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Inverter harmonic suppression based on adaptive resonant controller
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: With the increment of non-linear loads such as chargers, harmonics caused by those loads make much damage to the grid and other electrical equipment. The rectifier load as one of typical nonlinear load is taken as the research object in this paper. The output waveform optimization in harmonic suppression is the target. Firstly the double closed-loop control scheme is used to control the inverter and harmonics caused by the rectifier loads is analyzed. Then instantaneous reactive power theory is adopted to detect the harmonics. Finally adaptive proportional resonant controller is used to complete harmonic suppression and parameter adaptive adjustment. A simulation model of inverter system is established to analyze the harmonic content of the system under different control schemes. The output voltage harmonic content is reduced from 6.52% to 2.26% in the actual system, effectively improves the inverter output waveform quality. The result verifies the validity of proposed adaptive resonant controller.

articleTitle: Experimental and computational investigation for a household tri-generation with HES system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Tri-generation (electricity, heating, cooling) describes all energy generation systems that utilise recoverable waste heat for space heating, cooling, and domestic hot water purposes. Tri-generation is broadly considered as an alternative for the world to meet and solve energy-related problems, such as increase in energy demands and costs, energy supply security, and reducing carbon dioxide emissions. Diverse research on how to implement and utilise tri-generation system efficiently and effectively is booming at present. However, it is rarely reported in terms of the important relationship between efficiency improvement of tri-generation system and the reasonable utilisation of electrical energy in it. This paper discussed the reasons why the hybrid energy storage (HES) should be integrated into tri-generation system to promote its performance. And then an initial investigation of HES was carried out where, novel electrical storage components were employed to facilitate energy storage system which is regarded as a crucial part of tri-generation system. Furthermore, the performance of electrical energy storage and power supply subsystem was tested both in initial experimentation and simulation. The fact verified that innovative HES can promote the dynamics and improve the efficiency of tri-generation.

articleTitle: Personality predicting model based on user's linguistic behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Psychological studies have shown that the personality can affect the way on writing or talking. However, designing an effective model is a challenging task. The paper presents a personality analysis model to analyze the personality for micro-bloggers'. The model is based on the big-five model, and the evaluated dataset is collected by crawling micro-blog posts. KNN is used to verify the performance. The experimental results show the validity of the present model. Existing problems and further works are also presented in the end.

articleTitle: Hidden failure prognosis for navigation inertial platform using belief rule base expert system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The gyro drift is the main factor in affecting the performance of the inertial platform which is an important unit in the navigation system. The belief rule base (BRB) is used to construct the failure prognosis model of the inertial platform which holds the following characteristics: (1) the storage lives are long and working lives are short, (2) a lot of testing data can not be obtained, (3) some expert knowledge may be available, and (4) the failure is hidden. In order to solve the problems, two sub-BRBs are used with one employed to capture the relationship between the external stress and hidden failure and the other to construct the forecasting model of hidden failure. An experimental case study is examined to demonstrate the implementation and potential applications of the proposed failure prognosis model.

articleTitle: Rapid matching of line traces based on laser detection signal
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: It's usually not easy to compare line traces quickly and quantitatively with the current image processing and three-dimensional scanning methods. In order to deal with these kinds of problems, a similarity matching algorithm for laser detection signals of line traces is proposed. The proposed algorithm does section leveling for shear plant first, and then applies histogram to define the abnormal fluctuation data between the neighboring points, utilizes a K-Means clustering to eliminate the abnormal data. After that, locally weighted scatterplot smoothing algorithm is used to performs noise reduction on the surface signals of line traces that are picked up by a laser displacement sensor; followed by the identification of the features of `thick and consistent' trends in the signal data. Then the feature vectors are quantized by cosine vector curve fitting to individually calculate the spatial distance of the sample. Results from similarity comparison tests of actual cutting traces validate the accuracy and validity of proposed method.

articleTitle: Reusable launch vehicle fault detection and isolation based on UIO
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, a fault detection and isolation (FDI) method based on unknown input observer (UIO) is presented for the reusable launch vehicle (RLV), to meet the increasing demands for the safety, reliability, and maintainability. Considering RLV's common fault modes, the sensor fault is mainly analyzed. Then on the basis of the UIO preliminary theory study, an improved fault detection and isolation method based on full-order UIOs is proposed to facilitate the diagnosis of sensor faults. By introducing the generalized inverse approach to the FDI system, the effect of the unknown inputs can be decoupled from the residual signals, which makes the system sensitive to faults and insensitive to the unknown disturbances at the same time. Finally, simulation results of RLV demonstrate that the proposed FDI method is effective and satisfactory.

articleTitle: Hand target extraction from infrared images based on the danger theory
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The gray distribution of infrared thermal image is uneven, which brings difficulties to image segmentation. In this paper, based on the “the danger theory” of immunology, a method for hand segmentation is proposed. By using the dual-threshold of immune genetic algorithm, the image is segmented into a target pixel set, a background pixel set and a blurred pixel set. According to the timing characteristics of trace images, the 3D template is designed to extract features. According to the template characteristics, the danger signal is defined and the danger theory is used to identify the blurred pixel set. The proposed algorithm is compared with watershed method, active contour model and recent research achievements. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has a better performance of target extraction rate, coincidence with reference standard, and less absolute error rate.

articleTitle: Research on the tip-carbon nanotube interaction model using molecular dynamics simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In atomic force microscopy (AFM) based carbon nanotubes (CNTs) manipulation, the interaction force between AFM tip and CNT has a significant effect on the operation results. In this paper, we propose to simulate the contact model between AFM tip and carbon nanotube by using molecular dynamics simulation. In the proposed framework, different contact process (under different tip shapes, tip sizes, and contact positions) are also studied. The effectiveness of this proposed simulation is verified by comparing the simulation result with the literature result. This study explores atomic scale mechanical changes in the AFM tip-CNT interaction, providing a more accurate mechanical basis for AFM based CNT manipulation.

articleTitle: Harmonics elimination based six-phase permanent magnet synchronous generator with current injection at DC side
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method combing the Six-phase permanent magnet synchronous generation (PMSG) with 12-pulse series diode rectifier with active harmonic elimination at DC side in order to improve the quality of the ac line currents. The proposed scheme draws nearly sinusoidal currents by controlling the two sets of diode bridge output currents to be triangular and out of phase using the active PWM auxiliary circuit injects directly compensation currents at DC side. The compensation strategy is analyzed. The simulation results demonstrate that the 11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> 13<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> current harmonic in the Six-PMSG stator currents basically are eliminated, with multiply 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>, 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic content. But the total harmonic distortion (THD) of the Six-PMSG resultant current can be close to 1%.

articleTitle: Biomechanical model study of muscle tendon
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The three elements model of Hill is commonly used in biomechanical simulations to predict passive and active muscle forces. Here, a model is presented which consists of two elements: a series of elastic elements and a structure consisting of an elastic element and a damping element in parallel. So it is clear that the ternary viscoelastic mechanic model of muscle tendon consists of the binary model of muscle and the unitary model of tendon in series. The model has an important effect on the movement of the fingers, and it can help other researchers to design the exoskeleton rehabilitation robot hand better.

articleTitle: Primary user signal modulation type recognition algorithm based on joint cyclostationary PCA with RVM
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: To solve the problems of the low accuracy on detection and modulation type recognition of the weak primary users in low signal-to-noise ratio, a novel signal recognition method based on cyclostationary principal component analysis and relevant vector machine is proposed under the low signal to noise ratio environment in cognitive radio. The method combining principal component analysis with the relevant vector machine classification algorithm is applied to solve detection and modulation type recognition problem. Firstly, a set of cyclic spectrum features are calculated, and the principal component analysis is applied to extract the most discriminate feature vector as training samples and testing samples for classification. Secondly, the relevant vector machine is trained by the training samples. Finally, we utilize the trained relevant vector machine to detect and decide the modulation type of the primary user. It is observe that the maximum increase of the probability of detection on the proposed algorithm can increase 62% compared with artificial neural network, support vector machine and maximum-minimum eigenvalue. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm has high performance to recognition and the PUs can be detected effectively.

articleTitle: Command-filtered-based adaptive neural control for nonlinear systems with actuator saturation
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: We report an anti-disturbance command-filtered-based adaptive control for nonlinear systems with actuator saturation. The adaptive neural control is developed based on a coordinate transform, High-order sliding mode(HOSM) observer and neural network (NN) approximation, while only one NN is employed to online approximate uncertain functions. To avoid potential windup caused by unknown input saturation, an NN compensator is added to perform as active disturbance rejection term in the feedforward manner. Moreover, a tracking differentiator(TD) is employed to avoid “explosion of complexity” in traditional backstepping method. Simulation results indicate that the derived scheme can effectively compensate for the disturbance caused by the saturation and system uncertainties.

articleTitle: An UAV precision landing method based on virtual control point on the high voltage transmission line
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: A method for UAV landing precisely on ground wire of high voltage transmission line is proposed based-on virtual control points. It solves the problem of high complexity and low computational efficiency of traditional attitude estimation algorithm. Firstly, the iterative algorithm based on spatial collinearity error is used to improve the pose estimation velocity. Then, according to the idea of virtual control point in EPnP algorithm, the pose estimation accuracy of the iterative solution is improved without increasing the computational complexity. Finally, the performance of the algorithm is tested by simulation and unmanned aerial vehicle experiments. The results show that the algorithm not only maintains the pose estimation accuracy, but also can obtain the pose estimation speed better than the orthogonal iterative algorithm which has a broader application prospects.

articleTitle: H∞ tracking control problem for completely unknown nonlinear system based on augmented matrix
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper addresses the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> to tracking control problem for unknown nonlinear system based on the online ADP structure. We first use an identifier NN to approximate the unknown system. In order to transform the tracking problem into the regulation problem, the augmentation system is then constructed based on the identifier. Another NN is used to approximate the cost function in the HJI equation, such that H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> to tracking control pairs can be obtained without the solution of the HJI equation. Moreover, a novel estimation algorithm is developed to online update the NN weights simultaneously. Finally, a simulation is presented to demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Artificial seismic record synthesis based on basis function
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Artificial seismic record is widely used in the refined engineering design, but the traditional artificial seismic record synthesis method is very complicated. The traditional method involves a variety of empirical formula and statistical theories, which is puzzling and can not be directly understood by engineering staff. This paper presents a new method for synthesis of artificial seismic record based on a series of basis function. This new method takes the response spectrum under the exciting of single frequency sinusoidal ground movement as the basis function, obtaining synthesis of artificial seismic record by least square method. A numerical example is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the new method in this paper, and the results show that the new method is easy to understand and suitable for programming, and the artificial seismic record meets the requirements of the target generally.

articleTitle: Design and finite element analysis for the resin guiedvane
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In the common tapping, the pine barks need to be scraped and the side grooves, the middle grooves need to be cut by hand on the pine trunk, as well as the resin collector needs to be hung on the bamboo pendants which were nailed to the pine trunk. But the borehole tapping without scraping the pine barks and cutting the grooves on the pine, so borehole tapping possesses the lower labor intensity and the higher production efficiency than the common tapping; and the collected resin by borehole tapping is clean without the visible pollutants by human eyes, so it has been widely applied in the foreign countries. But borehole tapping is still in the experimental stage and the relative devices such as the borehole tapping machine and resin guiedvane are scarcely any studied and reported, to a certain extent these have delayed or hindered the application and popularization of borehole tapping in our country. In order to solve these problems, the resin guiedvane used in borehole tapping was designed, and its stress and strain with full-load were analyzed by the finite element analysis (FEA) in this paper. The analysis results have showed that the resin guiedvane didn't fracture and wasn't pulled off during resin tapping; moreover these analysis results were consistent with the practices. The other purpose of this paper is to provided some technical and theoretical references for the design and trial production the relative products, and to promote the development and application of borehole tapping in our country.

articleTitle: Design of an intelligent mobile robot based on Fischer model
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: An intelligent mobile robot was designed and developed to meet the demand of teaching and experimentation. The robot is a type of alloy guide coordinate manipulator model based on Fischer creative combination model platform. The robot model developed can catch and release objects in the space. Its movements are flexible and diverse. The intelligent mobile robot involves mechanics, electrical and hydraulic technology, automatic control technology, sensor technology and computer technology. The robopro software is used to program the robot, so that it can follow the design requirements and the procedures to complete the transfer of the work piece and handling, to meet the teaching experiment requirements. Practice has proved that the teaching robot designed has the advantages of low cost, easy to regulation, good repeatability and it has good promotion and application prospects in the field of teaching and experiment.

articleTitle: Improved NSGA-II algorithm for multi-objective scheduling problem in hybrid flow shop
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, multi-objective optimization for hybrid flow shop scheduling problem has been studied. The delivery time penalty and the load imbalance penalty are taken as the evaluation metrics. We describe the optimization framework for this hybrid flow shop problem, and design an improved NSGA-II algorithm for solution searching. Specifically, a multi-objective dynamic adaptive differential evolution algorithm (MODADE) is proposed to enhance the searching efficiency of the general differential evolution operations. MODADE calculates the similarity between different individuals based on their Hamming distance, and dynamically generates the high-similarity individuals for the population. We compare MODADE compared with the state-of-the-art algorithms, and the numerical result shows that the proposed MODADE algorithm outperforms others in terms of the algorithm convergence, the number and distribution of Pareto solutions.

articleTitle: Sensorless vector control strategy of induction motor with large torque output
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper describes a new sensorless vector control strategy for induction motor which can meet the requirements of constant large load torque, based on the comparative study of two observation methods for flux linkage, which are high-frequency signal injection method (HFSIM) and full order flux observer. In the low speed region, a high-frequency signal is injected, which is independent of the motor parameters. The rotor speed is identified by extracting the high frequency current. In the higher speed region, the rotor speed is obtained through full order flux observer to prevent the high-frequency torque ripple caused by HFSIM. An appropriate state switcher is proposed, in order to ensure smooth transition as the speed rises, as well as to ensure the accurate estimation of the rotor flux orientation angle within the whole speed range. The overall control strategy can output constant torque and satisfy heavily loaded condition. The experimental motor control test proves the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Modelling, identification and auto-tuning for controlled start transmissions
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper studied controlled start transmission (CST) control parameters tuning problems. First, modelling of CST gear, clutch dynamics and conveyor belt and materials have been introduced. Then sweep sine excitation has been applied into a CST clutch during factory test period to identify clutch dynamics parameters. Magnitude optimum and symmetrical optimum auto-tuning methods have been applied to power control loop and speed control loop respectively. Finally, simulation and experimental verification have been done to show the effectiveness of the methods.

articleTitle: Influence of liquid temperature on atomizing cone angle of internal mixing air atomizing nozzle
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The spray cone angle was obtained by the high speed camera shooting the nozzle atomization state of the internal mixing type air atomizing nozzle under the different liquor temperature, then with Photron FastCAM analysis software processing. And ANSYS15.0 is used to simulate the atomization under the same conditions, to get the same operating conditions of the spray cone angle. Simulation and experiment have good consistency. Results show that, with the increase of the liquor flow, the spray cone angle increased first and then decreased. The essential reasons of liquor temperature influence on the cone angle of atomization are given. The influence of the liquor temperature on the cone angle of the nozzle is so large that cannot be ignored, which can be used as a reference to improve the spray atomization effect of tobacco leaf.

articleTitle: Robust control strategy on output current of converter
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the output current waveform of converter is unstable and lack fidelity when the input source is unbalanced or the loads change, which is harmful to the operation of system, the Lyapunov function based control method is proposed. It controls the output current of converter by designed algorithm to avoid the error between settings and actual current and keeps it stable to improve the loading capability of converter under abnormal conditions. The proposed control strategy is verified in Matlab. Compared with traditional PID control strategy, the simulation results show that the designed control method plays an important role at anti-disturbance on output current on the conditions of unbalanced input sources and unbalanced loads, which verify the effectiveness and robustness of proposed control method. Simulation and experiment results show that the control strategy could improve the stability of output current and solve distortion problem, also it can improve the stability performance of the converters.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of gearboxes using feature extraction in time domain
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In the vibration signals of a faulty gearbox, there exist not only the response excited by source of faults such as rotating frequencies of shafts, mesh frequencies of gear pairs, their higher harmonic components and modulated components, but also natural and random vibrations of system, components and parts, and noise interferences. Thus it is difficult to recognize and capture typical fault frequencies. For this purpose, an approach was proposed for fault diagnosis of gearboxes, by combining temporal feature extraction based on independent component analysis (ICA) and fault classification based on forward least squares approximation support vector machine (FLSA-SVM). Multiple ICA neural networks were batch trained by multi-classes vibration data separately, each corresponding to one of fault patterns of gearboxes. A feature extractor was structurally constructed by the trained ICA networks, followed by a post-processing unit of feature extraction based on one second-order measure, i.e. residual total correlation (RTC). Experimental results show that the proposed approach is efficient and effective for fault diagnosis of gearboxes, even if the used train sets are of small size. The integrated ICA-RTC feature extractor is able to extract low-dimensional representative features from time-domain data, and to overcome some difficulties in traditional frequency-domain feature extraction.

Author Keywords: forward least squares approximation support vector machine (FLSA-SVM)

articleTitle: Multi-fault diagnosis for rolling bearing based on double parallel extreme learning machine & kurtosis spectral entropy
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, double parallel feedforward extreme learning machine (DP-ELM) model and kurtosis spectral entropy (KSE) are proposed for the early weak multi-fault diagnosis for rolling bearing. Extreme learning machine (ELM) has been widely used as a fast classification model. But a key problem for ELM is to reduce the impact of random variables and it can't make full use of the direct and indirect information among different layers. To solve the problems, a connection is built between the input layer and the output layer. That is, the output layer receives information not only from the hidden layer but also directly from the input layer. And a set of the input layer weights and the hidden layer thresholds will be chosen analytically by founding the best accuracy. Meanwhile, feature extraction is the prerequisite for classification. In order to improve the accuracy of the multi-fault classification, this paper applies the kurtosis spectral entropy (KSE) algorithm to get the useful features from the vibration signals. Then the eigenvalues are input into the DP-ELM model for pattern recognition. In this paper, two sets of rolling bearing data at different speed are used to test. And each set of data includes six different states. Compared with ELM, back propagation neuron network (BP) and radial basis function (RBF), the experimental results show that, with as few as possible of the hidden nodes, the improved method used in this paper ensures a short learning time that it might learn hundreds of times faster than BP method, and obviously increases the accuracy at a degree. Finally, 10 times 10-fold-cross-validation are used to prove the effectiveness.

articleTitle: A new static strain measurement method of young's modulus based on the theory of the finite element
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Measurement methods of Young's modulus about static state by beam bending, there are some issues such as having low precision, the range of application is limited, required the special equipment and specimen. Therefore, this paper presents a new strain Measurement Method of Young's modulus about static state based on the theory of Finite Element. Firstly, by studying the relationship among the load, strain, and the stiffness matrix in Finite Element, to establish a relationship between strain and the Young's modulus. Secondly, the paper analyzes the sources of error, and the impact of the raw measurement error and finite element calculation error on its results. Finally, the paper's result is verified by concrete examples, and it's been proved that this method doesn't require special equipments and specimens, with high testing accuracy, besides, it is widely applied to engineering practice.

articleTitle: Optimal adaptive parameter estimation-based tracking control of motor turntable servo system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal adaptive parameter estimation (OAPE) method is proposed to estimate the disturbance and the unknown parameters of the motor turntable servo system. Different from the conventional adaptive parameter estimation (APE), the estimation error of OAPE is driven by the adaptive law with the time-varying gain which is developed by utilizing the filtering technique and minimizing the cost function. By implying OAPE, the exponential convergence of estimation errors is guaranteed. The nonsingular time-varying terminal sliding mode (NTVTSM) controller is designed, which achieves the position tracking of the system with small tracking errors. Simulation are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Teleoperation control for bimanual robots based on RBFNN and wave variable
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, a dual arm control method in a tele-operation system is introduced. For a bimanual robot, moving a common object precisely requires real-time cooperation between the two arms. In such conditions the force interaction including the internal forces applied on the object must be taken into account. Therefore the dynamics models for master device, slave robot and the object are first analysed. Because the presence of the uncertainties in the dynamics model of the remote robot, a neural network method is used for compensation in the slave part. In order to guarantee the stability of the teleoperation system, the wave variable approach is employed in the communication part. Then the controllers in both the master and the slave part are designed based on their dynamics models. Then the tracking convergence and system stability are proven by the Lyapunov function. Several simulation experiments are carried out to show the good performance of trajectory tracking and force reflection.

articleTitle: Improved imperialist competitive algorithm for flexible flow shop scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the flexible flow-shop scheduling problem (FFSP). The mathematical model is established to minimize the makespan. Improved Imperialist Competitive Algorithm (IICA) is proposed as the global searching mechanism for this optimization problem. Based on the standard imperialist competitive algorithm, two improvements, reform operation and elite individual retention strategy have been introduced. At the same time, to improve the diversity of solutions, the Hamming distance has also been introduced to select the individuals. Through the standard instance tests, the proposed IICA outperforms the genetic algorithm and the standard imperialist competitive algorithm in terms of the convergence speed and global optimum searching for the flexible flow-shop scheduling problem<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: A weak target detection method based on spatial power spectrum map (SPS-MAP)
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the detection probability of the moving platform using traditional detection method is low and even bad under low SNR condition. A weak target detection method based on spatial power spectrum map (SPS-MAP) is put forward. Compared with traditional cross direction finding method, this method omits the step in which the location is determined with the “post processed” SPS peak information and instead maps the SPS curve directly to the search grid to achieve the purpose of location as detection. In this thesis, the theoretical properties and computational complexity of the method are deduced and analyzed. At last, simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively detect targets in low SNR conditions.

articleTitle: Detection of bearing-only trajectory of multi-target using Hidden Markov model
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Detection and track of the weak trajectory in the Bearing-Time Record (BTR) is an important method to discover and localize the target automatically in passive sonar. An algorithm to detect and track the trajectories of multi-targets in the BTR is proposed in this paper. It doesn't need the number of targets as prior information, and initial or terminate the trajectory automatically. The tracking of each trajectory is independent and can be parallelized. The detection performance is analyzed by the simulation. The effectiveness of this algorithm is also shown by a real acoustic data from experiments on the sea.

articleTitle: Switching multiple model adaptive control of a class of uncertain discrete-time system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: A switching multiple model adaptive control scheme for linear discrete time-invariant plant and parameter jump plant is presented with stability and convergence analysis. Specifically, based on the virtual equivalent system concept and corresponding methodology, unified criteria on the stability and convergence of switching multiple model adaptive control are obtained. The proposed criteria are independent of specific control strategy, parameter estimation algorithm.

articleTitle: A multi populations cooperative search algorithm based on undirected weighted graph
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of premature convergence for particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, a multi populations cooperative search algorithm based on undirected weighted graph is proposed to improve the accuracy of optimization. Then the evolution model of multi populations cooperative network is established on the basis of undirected weighted graph and a multi populations bidirectional interactive pattern is constructed, whose asynchronous parallel search algorithm is given at the same time. Finally experimental results on several benchmark function show that the presented algorithm can rapidly converge at very high quality solutions.

articleTitle: The influence of stiffened ribs on vibration of a thin-walled casing
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Thin-walled casings with stiffened ribs are widely used in aero engine structures. Reasonable arrangements of positions and forms for ribs can play a significant role in restraining resonance. In this paper, influences of stiffened ribs on the vibration characteristics of the engine inlet casing were studied using finite element (FE) analysis. Experimental studies were carried out to verify the results of the FE analysis. Firstly, by means of FE software, parametric models of the inlet casing with stiffened ribs were created. And then based on the actual working conditions, dynamics of the thin-walled casing with annular stiffened ribs were calculated and discussed. The influence laws of positions of annular ribs, casing wall thickness and cross-sectional dimensions (height and width) of the thin-walled casing structure parameters for the vibration characteristics were studied, which provide empirical data for the design and optimization of engine thin-walled casings with stiffened ribs.

articleTitle: Application of nonlinear optimization method in stereo visual odometry
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Nonlinear optimization approaches are becoming more prevalent in the field of navigation with visual sensors. Therefore, this paper presented a refinement motion estimation approach which showed the advantages compared to the typical method. The proposed framework included established observation model and the mathematical derivation of nonlinear optimization algorithm. Speaking of model part, the relationship between frame pixels and the coarse pose estimated by RANSAC was quantized by a formula which became a prerequisite for optimization. While in the nonlinear optimization part, one strategy was taken into consideration to reduce the cumulative error. That is to say, the current pose was optimized each time a new frame comes. Finally, tests on the Malaga urban datasets verified that this approach achieved higher accuracy than the RANSAC estimation. As a result, benefits of using nonlinear optimization in motion estimation refinement were verified, which could also provide important priori information for simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM).

articleTitle: Model based utopian social evolution
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: With the development of economy and science and the deterioration of the environment, people strive to explore the new planet for human habitation. At present, Mars is considered to have a small amount of water on the surface and may be suitable for human habitation. This article selected three states in the US Census website, including Alaska (AK), South Dakota (SD) and Vermont (VT) for a total of 10,000 people. We use mathematical modeling method to simulate the migration of population to Mars after the construction of utopian social education, economy and labor relations. Then we deduced the next 10 years, 50 years, 100 years of social development.

articleTitle: Multi-channels turbo equalization for M-ary orthogonal modulation signal
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: M-ary orthogonal modulation is widely used in wireless communication systems as a frequency spread method. To improve the demodulation performance of this signal with low signal to noise ratio (SNR) in severe intersymbol interference (ISI) channel, a multi-channels turbo equalization algorithm is proposed. In this algorithm, a new soft demapping and mapping method is presented and the extrinsic information is exchanged between the multi-channels equalizer and the decoder. Simulation indicates gains of up to 4.5 dB relative to the hard symbol decision algorithm and 3.5dB relative to the single-channel turbo equalization algorithm can be achieved after two iterations.

articleTitle: The constrained modal and transient stress analysis of diesel engine crankshaft
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Based on the three-dimensional model of the crankshaft of a four cylinder diesel engine, this paper analyzes the stress and strain state of the crankshaft in a working cycle by transient dynamic method. It is concluded that the maximum stress value occurs at the maximum cylinder pressure of the second cylinder neck and the crankshaft fillet when the third cylinder is ignited and check the crankshaft strength. Finally, the analysis of the first ten order modes of the crankshaft is carried out. Through the analysis of the modal and transient response of the crankshaft, it can provide some reference for the design and development of the crankshaft.

articleTitle: Modeling and fault simulation analysis of triplex redundance servovalve
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The paper is based on the technological transformation project from a certain institute. The objective is to test the stability and reliability of the triplex redundance servovalve. Considering the complicated structure and the basic principle of triplex redundance servovalve, the mathematical model of the valve is established. Based on the mathematical model, the performance of the triplex redundance servovalve when faults appear can be simulated and analysed. The faults include the coil disconnection and current full bias.

articleTitle: Object-oriented change detection based on change magnitude fusion in multitemporal very high resolution images
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Very high resolution image shows more detail information of objects on the earth's surface, which makes the traditional pixel-based change detection technique unsuitable for it. The paper proposes a method of object-oriented change detection based on change magnitude fusion in multitemporal very high resolution images. The method can be divided into three steps: 1) Object-oriented image segmentation by multi-scale morphological watershed image segmentation algorithm based on gradient image and marker image. 2) Feature vectors of image objects extraction based on spectral and texture feature. 3) Multitemporal change magnitude maps generation based on change vector analysis, and then the fusion image of change magnitude map can be obtained based on image fusion method, which leads to get change areas by optimum threshold. Experiments show the feasibility and effectiveness of the method proposed by quantitative and qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: A new tracking control design for the aero-engine: A fuzzy approach
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: In this paper, a new approach for the control design of the fuzzy dynamic system is proposed. For the fuzzy dynamic system, the uncertainty is described by the fuzzy sets. The controller has two folds, one designs for the nominal system, and another compensates the uncertain portion. The controller is deterministic and not if-then based. The controlled system will be proven to be uniformly bounded and uniformly ultimately bounded. The fuzzy set about the uncertainty will evolve into an optimal problem associated with the parameter of the control. For the tracking control design, the error is augmented to the system. A certain type aero-engine will be simulated to demonstrate the superiority of the control.

articleTitle: The semantic similarity relation of entities discovery: Using word embedding
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Recently, word embedding performs well in many natural language processing tasks, which one of is capturing syntactic and semantic word relationships. It can be used in many other research fields, such as recommendation and knowledge base. In this paper, we propose a method that uses the word embedding to capture the semantic similarities of entities. We divide the projection layer into two parts: one is entity, and the other is non-entity, and add the non-entities to the negative sampling of target entities. By iterating over each sentence, the entities are embedded in the entity vector space. For the experiments, we use two kinds of text corpus, the total words of each approximates 50 million to learn the entity vectors. Finally, the experiments show that our model is faster than Skip-gram model in training task and do the better in the calculation of semantic similarity entities.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional reconstruction technique based on scattering point extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to find a more effective way to reconstruct the structure of a target. In this paper, the principle of ISAR and InISAR signal formation and imaging are analyzed by the perspective of analyzing the target linear frequency modulation echo signal and combining with ISAR imaging algorithm. We proposed a method of InISAR scattering point extraction technology based on CLEAN algorithm and threshold processing. And compare it to the method of image matching reconstruction. The simulation results show that the InISAR reconstruction technique based on scattering point extraction method is a more effective one, with higher detection probability and has an ability to suppress the influence of noise and sidelobe effect, under the condition of noise.

articleTitle: Interval type-2 fuzzy logic system for the double tank water level control system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Interval type-2 fuzzy sets used in fuzzy logic system was called interval type-2fuzzy logic system. For high-order big inertial object, the good control effect cannot be reached if normal PID control method is employed. In this paper, a interval type-2 fuzzy controller is designed based on fuzzy control theory. It can automatically modulate parameters in real-time according to the deviations and the varying rate of deviations. MATLAB simulation results show that this fuzzy controller can provide better control effect than normal PID controllers, and can greatly improves the dynamic and stable performance of the system.

articleTitle: Design and modelling of energy-efficient electro-hydrostatic actuators under gravity loads
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Large scale synchronous load-lifting systems are in growing demands since they have unique advantages in reconstruction of massive bridges or buildings. However, the traditional lifting systems suffers severe energy consumption. This paper designs a new type of Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators(EHA) using double variable pump and accumulators with designated pressures specified for heavy lifting systems. The designed EHA balances part of the gravity loads with accumulators, overwhelmingly inducing the energy consumption. The motor speed and the pump displacement can be adjusted synchronously, thus, the EHA system will have greater range of regulation and control redundancy. Based on analysis of the working principle of the designed EHA, the complete mathematical model of the pump controlled asymmetric cylinder is established.

articleTitle: A vision based high tension line detection system
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: This paper focuses on obstacle detection during low height flight tasks. Flight obstacles such as high tension lines are difficult to detect using radar or laser sensors, because they don't have enough reflection area. To resolve this problem, a vision based detection method is proposed in this paper. The proposed method detects both high tension lines and line pylons within the pictures captured from the front-view of the aircraft by long focus cameras. A detection system based on the proposed method is also built in this paper. The test results prove that the performance of the system is satisfying enough for a real application.

articleTitle: Real time harmonics control technique with fixed switching in indirect field oriented control
publicationTitle: 2017 9th International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control (ICMIC)
abstract: Direct torque control, direct or indirect field-oriented control, are the most important control techniques applied in induction motor drive systems. This paper presents the indirect field-oriented control based on fuzzy logic proportional-integral controller for an induction motor. In order to reduce the loss of the power device the real time harmonics control/elimination (RTHC) strategy is proposed to control the voltage source inverter. The solutions of the switching patterns to eliminate the desired harmonics are given by using the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm. With a different tests mode at each change of speed or load (torque), the modulation index is in reality variable as a consequence of the variability of the voltage (amplitude). A simple interpolation method called Lagrange polynomial, for generation the parameters of RTHC have been proposed.
